`form.references` will download and cache the reference data required by form models.

The package skeleton is ready; the download API is not implemented yet.

The planned workflow reads a catalogue, resolves model references and verifies downloaded files before caching them.

Code-list and registry locations, model mappings and authentication belong to the calling application.
